title: Terraforming technology and resource cost

provenance.note: Min/Max auto-build and manual Terraform Environment; order chosen by habitability improvement.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 510938 (0x0007cbda), HLP file offset 133583 (0x000209cf), topic 54 'Types of Terraforming Technology'

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 525488 (0x000804b0), HLP file offset 135845 (0x000212a5), topic 55 'Total Terraforming'

setup.baseline: An owned planet with a known environment and no terraforming technology.
setup.variable: Terraforming technology level, attribute and task type.

procedure: Record environment and habitability before and after one terraform task.
Test temperature, gravity and radiation separately.
Compare Min, Max and manual Terraform Environment.
Repeat with Total Terraforming and Claim Adjuster.

documented: Terraforming technologies improve gravity, temperature or radiation; without Total Terraforming each improves at least 3% and at most 15% (documented-only).
Terraforming tasks use only possessed technology and act first on the attribute that most improves habitability (documented-only).
Total Terraforming starts at 3%, reaches 30%, costs 30% fewer resources and requires only Biotechnology research (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact resource cost per percentage is unknown.
The ordering of simultaneous Min/Max tasks is only partly documented.
Claim Adjuster temporary terraforming interaction is unknown.
